setting: school and home research scenes; navy uniform at school and casual home clothes; questions may appear as soft visual thought vignettes without readable text

sentences.english: On a rainy Sunday, I sat by the window and wondered about many things.
sentences.japanese: 雨の日曜日、窓辺に座って、いろんなことに思いをめぐらせました。

sentences.english: I do not know where my brother went.
sentences.japanese: 兄がどこへ行ったのか、わたしは知らない。

sentences.english: I wanted to understand why my sister was crying.
sentences.japanese: 妹がなぜ泣いていたのか、わかってあげたい。

sentences.english: I even tried to guess what my mother was making for dinner.
sentences.japanese: 母が夕ご飯に何を作っているのか、想像してみたりもする。

sentences.english: I wanted to call Tom and ask him, “Can you tell me what time you will come tomorrow?”
sentences.japanese: トムに電話して、「明日何時に来るか教えてくれる?」と聞いてみたくなりました。

sentences.english: I have wondered for a long time where my father studied when he was young.
sentences.japanese: 父が若い頃にどこで勉強していたのか、わたしはずっと気になっていました。

sentences.english: But I could not ask him easily.
sentences.japanese: でも、なかなか聞けなかった。
今日こそ聞いてみるつもりです。

sentences.english: There are so many things I want to know.
sentences.japanese: 知りたいことがたくさんある。

sentences.english: Each time I try, the world around me seems to grow a little wider.
sentences.japanese: そのたびに、わたしの世界が少しずつ広がっていく気がするんです。
